title: Shared Buffer Keystroke Audit
brief: Two keyboards type into one shared text buffer in a collaborative editor. Each device keeps its own keystroke log, and when a buffer looks corrupted we want to check whether it could have come from those two logs.

Implement isFaithfulMerge(s1, s2, s3), where s1 and s2 are the keystroke logs of the two devices and s3 is the final buffer, and return true if s3 can be produced by weaving together the keystrokes of s1 and s2 while keeping each device's keystrokes in their original order, or false otherwise.
